item.title: Talk with Murph on the website
item.summary: Open Voice to speak with your Murph assistant and hear its answers, with readable captions, mute, and end-call controls.
item.details: Your microphone starts only when you choose Start call. Calls count toward your AI usage. Leaving the page ends the call; work Murph has already accepted can finish afterward. Requested reminders arrive through your connected messaging channel, which Murph names when confirming them.
